Name: Agent Deck
Author: Zachary Rubin
Description: Shows your AI coding agents on the deck. Keys blink when an agent needs a decision; the touch strip says what it needs.

Actions.Name: Agent slot
Actions.Tooltip: Shows one running agent, or a recently used app when no agent needs the key. Press to jump to it.

Actions.Name: Agent status strip
Actions.Tooltip: Put one on each knob. Together they show what the featured agent needs.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Cycle featured agent (1st knob moves through Spotlight results while the launcher is open; 2nd picks a tab, conversation, chat or note when the strip lists them; 3rd scrolls; 4th moves between fields)
TriggerDescription.Push: Answer the permission shown above this knob; otherwise: 1st opens Spotlight and dictates, stops, then opens the pick; 2nd opens the picked tab, conversation, chat or note (or jumps to what the strip shows); 3rd dictates; 4th clicks
TriggerDescription.Touch: Answer the permission shown above this spot, or jump to featured agent
